scope.label: What to preserve (claims, subjects and systems)

body.h: 1. Why you are receiving this notice

body.p: Fontara reasonably anticipates litigation or a formal proceeding concerning {{matter}}. Fontara has a legal duty to preserve all information that may be relevant to it. You have been identified as a custodian: a person who may hold such information. This notice takes effect immediately and overrides any retention or deletion schedule that would otherwise apply.

Preserve every document and item of electronically stored information, in whatever form and wherever kept, that relates to: {{scope}}. This covers material created or received on or after {{period_start}}, and earlier material that relates to the same subjects.

list: Email, chat and messaging (including Slack, Teams and text messages on any device used for Fontara business)
Documents and files on Fontara systems, shared drives, cloud services and personal devices
Agreements, amendments, drafts and signature records, including documents that were never signed or countersigned
Invoices, billing and system records, calendars, notes and paper files

body.p: Do not delete, discard, alter, overwrite, re-sign, amend or correct any of this material, and do not change auto-delete settings to shorten them. Do not move material out of Fontara systems. If you are unsure whether something is covered, preserve it.

This hold remains in effect until Fontara Legal releases it in writing, even if you change roles or leave Fontara. Before you leave, tell Fontara Legal so your data can be preserved before your accounts are closed. You may receive periodic reminders.
Contact {{legal_contact}} with any question about this notice. Do not discuss the matter with anyone outside Fontara.
